messages:
Dana H.: Uploading pen-test + vuln-scan bundle for Acme vendor review. Zip contains: pen-test.pdf, nessus.xml, nmap.txt, remediation-tracker.csv, per-issue evidence, attestation draft. S3: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/artifacts/acme_pkg_1792004321.zip
SHA256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855

SecurityBot: Scan summary (tools: Nessus Pro, nmap 7.93): Findings = 0 CRITICAL, 2 HIGH, 6 MEDIUM, 3 LOW. Tracker includes CVE refs and suggested mitigations. :mag:

Ravi P.: Sales needs tracker to include owner, owning team, ETA (YYYY-MM-DD), change-request ID, and on-call contact. Also confirm we can provide an InfoSec-signed attestation and a short customer-facing summary.

Dana H.: Added columns to remediation-tracker.csv and updated the zip. Sample rows (full CSV in bundle):
```
issue_id,summary,severity,owner,team,eta,change_req,oncall
AC-2026-01,Admin UI default creds,HIGH,Marta L.,Platform Security,2026-04-08,CHG-8450,oncall@redwood.com
AC-2026-07,Deprecated TLS cipher suites,MEDIUM,Infra Ops,Infra,2026-04-12,CHG-8451,oncall@redwood.com
```

Marta L.: For AC-2026-01: default creds found on a mis-tagged dev image. Plan: rotate creds, revoke sessions, remove dev tag. I can execute rotation tomorrow night; ETA 2026-04-08 to include verification. Evidence files: AC-2026-01-creds-screenshot.png, auth-log-snippet.txt.

Ravi P.: Please add verification commands to the tracker (e.g., auth log grep, nmap checks) and include the change board ticket link in the email. Customer asked for a 1-2 sentence summary and assurance we'll respond to clarifying questions within 48 hours.

Dana H.: Draft customer-facing summary: "Redwood completed an external pen-test and vulnerability scan for your environment. We identified several issues and have provided remediation owners, timelines, and evidence; an InfoSec-signed attestation confirming no customer data exposure is included."

Marta L.: I'll attach post-change verification outputs to the evidence folder after the maintenance window and update CHG-8450 with rollback steps.

SecurityBot: Reminder: default retention for security artifacts = 90 days. If Legal requires longer retention for Acme, open a ticket in #legal-retention.

Ravi P.: Sales will send the bundle to Acme tomorrow 09:00 PT. Please ensure the attestation is signed and the tracker shows on-call contact. I'll include CHG-8450 in the outbound email.

Dana H.: I'll GPG-sign the attestation and upload a v2 of the zip once signed. Keeping the S3 object versioned until legal signs off. Closing thread unless further edits.
